name: Cure Wounds
description: Level 1 Abjuration (Bard, Doctor, Druid, Warden, Navigator) Casting Time: Action Range: Touch Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous A creature you touch regains a number of Health equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
